1.english_reference: And it came to pass in the eleventh year

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֛י בְּ עַשְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה
traditions.VUL: Et factum est in undécimo anno ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass in the eleventh year ,

1.english_reference: in the first [ day ] of the month

traditions.WLC: בְּ אֶחָ֣ד לַ חֹ֑דֶשׁ
traditions.VUL: prima mensis ,
traditions.KJV: in the first [ day ] of the month , [ that ]

1.english_reference: [ that ] the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.VUL: factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis ,
traditions.KJV: Son of man ,

2.english_reference: because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁר אָ֨מְרָה צֹּ֤ר עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙
traditions.VUL: pro eo quod dixit Tyrus de Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem ,

2.english_reference: Aha , she is broken [ that was ] the gates of the people

traditions.WLC: הֶאָ֔ח נִשְׁבְּרָ֛ה דַּלְת֥וֹת הָ עַמִּ֖ים
traditions.VUL: Euge , confráctæ sunt portæ populórum ,
traditions.KJV: Aha , she is broken [ that was ] the gates of the people :

traditions.WLC: נָסֵ֣בָּה אֵלָ֑ י
traditions.VUL: convérsa est ad me :
traditions.KJV: she is turned unto me :

traditions.WLC: אִמָּלְאָ֖ה
traditions.VUL: implébor ,
traditions.KJV: I shall be replenished , [ now ]

traditions.WLC: הָחֳרָֽבָה
traditions.VUL: desérta est .
traditions.KJV: she is laid waste :

3.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

3.english_reference: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , O Tyrus

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֥י עָלַ֖יִ ךְ צֹ֑ר
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego super te Tyre ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , O Tyrus ,

3.english_reference: and will cause many nations to come up against thee

traditions.WLC: וְ הַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עָלַ֨יִ ךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים
traditions.VUL: et ascéndere fáciam ad te gentes multas ,
traditions.KJV: and will cause many nations to come up against thee ,

3.english_reference: as the sea causeth his waves to come up

traditions.WLC: כְּ הַעֲל֥וֹת הַ יָּ֖ם לְ גַלָּֽי ו
traditions.VUL: sicut ascéndit mare flúctuans .
traditions.KJV: as the sea causeth his waves to come up .

4.english_reference: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁחֲת֞וּ חֹמ֣וֹת צֹ֗ר
traditions.VUL: Et dissipábunt muros Tyri ,
traditions.KJV: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָֽרְסוּ֙ מִגְדָּלֶ֔י הָ
traditions.VUL: et déstruent turres eius :
traditions.KJV: and break down her towers :

4.english_reference: I will also scrape her dust from her

traditions.WLC: וְ סִֽחֵיתִ֥י עֲפָרָ֖ הּ מִמֶּ֑ נָּה
traditions.VUL: et radam púlverem eius de ea ,
traditions.KJV: I will also scrape her dust from her ,

4.english_reference: and make her like the top of a rock

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֖ הּ לִ צְחִ֥יחַ סָֽלַע
traditions.VUL: et dabo eam in limpidíssimam petram .
traditions.KJV: and make her like the top of a rock .

5.english_reference: It shall be [ a place for ] the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea

traditions.WLC: מִשְׁטַ֨ח חֲרָמִ֤ים תִּֽהְיֶה֙ בְּ ת֣וֹךְ הַ יָּ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Siccátio sagenárum erit in médio maris ,
traditions.KJV: It shall be [ a place for ] the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea :

5.english_reference: for I have spoken [ it ] , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֑ה
traditions.VUL: quia ego locútus sum , ait Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: for I have spoken [ it ] , saith the Lord GOD :

5.english_reference: and it shall become a spoil to the nations

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָ֥ה לְ בַ֖ז לַ גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.VUL: et erit in direptiónem géntibus .
traditions.KJV: and it shall become a spoil to the nations .

6.english_reference: And her daughters which [ are ] in the field shall be slain by the sword

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנוֹתֶ֨י הָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ שָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּ חֶ֖רֶב תֵּהָרַ֑גְנָה
traditions.VUL: Fíliæ quoque eius , quæ sunt in agro , gládio interficiéntur :
traditions.KJV: And her daughters which [ are ] in the field shall be slain by the sword ;

6.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

7.english_reference: For thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the Lord GOD ;

7.english_reference: Behold , I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל צֹ֗ר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego addúcam ad Tyrum Nabuchodónosor regem Babylónis
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon ,

7.english_reference: a king of kings , from the north

traditions.WLC: מִ צָּפ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מְלָכִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: ab aquilóne , regem regum ,
traditions.KJV: a king of kings , from the north ,

7.english_reference: with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people

traditions.WLC: בְּ ס֛וּס וּ בְ רֶ֥כֶב וּ בְ פָרָשִׁ֖ים וְ קָהָ֥ל וְ עַם רָֽב
traditions.VUL: cum equis , et cúrribus , et equítibus , et cœtu , populóque magno .
traditions.KJV: with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people .

8.english_reference: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field

traditions.WLC: בְּנוֹתַ֥יִ ךְ בַּ שָּׂדֶ֖ה בַּ חֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֑ג
traditions.VUL: Fílias tuas , quæ sunt in agro , gládio interfíciet :
traditions.KJV: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field :

8.english_reference: and he shall make a fort against thee

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַ֨ן עָלַ֜יִ ךְ דָּיֵ֗ק
traditions.VUL: et circúmdabit te munitiónibus ,
traditions.KJV: and he shall make a fort against thee ,

8.english_reference: and cast a mount against thee

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁפַ֤ךְ עָלַ֨יִ ךְ֙ סֹֽלְלָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: et comportábit ággerem in gyro ,
traditions.KJV: and cast a mount against thee ,

8.english_reference: and lift up the buckler against thee

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵקִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִ ךְ צִנָּֽה
traditions.VUL: et elevábit contra te clýpeum .
traditions.KJV: and lift up the buckler against thee .

9.english_reference: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls

traditions.WLC: וּ מְחִ֣י קָֽבָלּ֔ וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּ חֹֽמוֹתָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Et víneas , et aríetes temperábit in muros tuos ,
traditions.KJV: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls ,

9.english_reference: and with his axes he shall break down thy towers

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֨גְדְּלֹתַ֔יִ ךְ יִתֹּ֖ץ בְּ חַרְבוֹתָֽי ו
traditions.VUL: et turres tuas déstruet in armatúra sua .
traditions.KJV: and with his axes he shall break down thy towers .

10.english_reference: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee

traditions.WLC: מִ שִּׁפְעַ֥ת סוּסָ֖י ו יְכַסֵּ֣ ךְ אֲבָקָ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: Inundatióne equórum eius opériet te pulvis eórum :
traditions.KJV: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee :

10.english_reference: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen , and of the wheels , and of the chariots

traditions.WLC: מִ קּוֹל֩ פָּרַ֨שׁ וְ גַלְגַּ֜ל וָ רֶ֗כֶב תִּרְעַ֨שְׁנָה֙ חֽוֹמוֹתַ֔יִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: a sónitu équitum , et rotárum , et cúrruum movebúntur muri tui ,
traditions.KJV: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen , and of the wheels , and of the chariots ,

10.english_reference: when he shall enter into thy gates

traditions.WLC: בְּ בֹא וֹ֙ בִּ שְׁעָרַ֔יִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: cum ingréssus fúerit portas tuas
traditions.KJV: when he shall enter into thy gates ,

10.english_reference: as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach

traditions.WLC: כִּ מְבוֹאֵ֖י עִ֥יר מְבֻקָּעָֽה
traditions.VUL: quasi per intróitum urbis dissipátæ .
traditions.KJV: as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach .

11.english_reference: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets

traditions.WLC: בְּ פַרְס֣וֹת סוּסָ֔י ו יִרְמֹ֖ס אֶת כָּל חֽוּצוֹתָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Ungulis equórum suórum conculcábit omnes platéas tuas :
traditions.KJV: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets :

11.english_reference: he shall slay thy people by the sword

traditions.WLC: עַמֵּ ךְ֙ בַּ חֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֔ג
traditions.VUL: pópulum tuum gládio cædet ,
traditions.KJV: he shall slay thy people by the sword ,

11.english_reference: and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground

traditions.WLC: וּ מַצְּב֥וֹת עֻזֵּ֖ ךְ לָ אָ֥רֶץ תֵּרֵֽד
traditions.VUL: et státuæ tuæ nóbiles in terram córruent .
traditions.KJV: and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .

12.english_reference: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁלְל֣וּ חֵילֵ֗ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Vastábunt opes tuas ,
traditions.KJV: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches ,

12.english_reference: and make a prey of thy merchandise

traditions.WLC: וּ בָֽזְזוּ֙ רְכֻלָּתֵ֔ ךְ
traditions.VUL: dirípient negotiatiónes tuas :
traditions.KJV: and make a prey of thy merchandise :

12.english_reference: and they shall break down thy walls

traditions.WLC: וְ הָֽרְסוּ֙ חוֹמוֹתַ֔יִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: et déstruent muros tuos ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall break down thy walls ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָתֵּ֥י חֶמְדָּתֵ֖ ךְ יִתֹּ֑צוּ
traditions.VUL: et domos tuas præcláras subvértent :
traditions.KJV: and destroy thy pleasant houses :

12.english_reference: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲבָנַ֤יִ ךְ וְ עֵצַ֨יִ ךְ֙ וַֽ עֲפָרֵ֔ ךְ בְּ ת֥וֹךְ מַ֖יִם יָשִֽׂימוּ
traditions.VUL: et lápides tuos , et ligna tua , et púlverem tuum in médio aquárum ponent .
traditions.KJV: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water .

13.english_reference: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease

traditions.WLC: וְ הִשְׁבַּתִּ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁירָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Et quiéscere fáciam multitúdinem canticórum tuórum :
traditions.KJV: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease ;

13.english_reference: and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard

traditions.WLC: וְ ק֣וֹל כִּנּוֹרַ֔יִ ךְ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עֽוֹד
traditions.VUL: et sónitus citharárum tuárum non audiétur ámplius .
traditions.KJV: and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard .

14.english_reference: And I will make thee like the top of a rock

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַתִּ֞י ךְ לִ צְחִ֣יחַ סֶ֗לַע
traditions.VUL: Et dabo te in limpidíssimam petram ,
traditions.KJV: And I will make thee like the top of a rock :

14.english_reference: thou shalt be [ a place ] to spread nets upon

traditions.WLC: מִשְׁטַ֤ח חֲרָמִים֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה
traditions.VUL: siccátio sagenárum eris ,
traditions.KJV: thou shalt be [ a place ] to spread nets upon ;

14.english_reference: thou shalt be built no more

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה ע֑וֹד
traditions.VUL: nec ædificáberis ultra :
traditions.KJV: thou shalt be built no more :

14.english_reference: for I the LORD have spoken [ it ] , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.VUL: quia ego locútus sum , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: for I the LORD have spoken [ it ] , saith the Lord GOD .

16.english_reference: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones

traditions.WLC: וְֽ יָרְד֞וּ מֵ עַ֣ל כִּסְאוֹתָ֗ ם כֹּ֚ל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַ יָּ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Et descéndent de sédibus suis omnes príncipes maris :
traditions.KJV: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones ,

16.english_reference: and lay away their robes , and put off their broidered garments

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵסִ֨ירוּ֙ אֶת מְעִ֣ילֵי הֶ֔ם וְ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתָ֖ ם יִפְשֹׁ֑טוּ
traditions.VUL: et áuferent exúvias suas , et vestiménta sua vária abícient ,
traditions.KJV: and lay away their robes , and put off their broidered garments :

16.english_reference: they shall clothe themselves with trembling

traditions.WLC: חֲרָד֤וֹת יִלְבָּ֨שׁוּ֙
traditions.VUL: et induéntur stupóre :
traditions.KJV: they shall clothe themselves with trembling ;

16.english_reference: they shall sit upon the ground

traditions.WLC: עַל הָ אָ֣רֶץ יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ
traditions.VUL: in terra sedébunt ,
traditions.KJV: they shall sit upon the ground ,

16.english_reference: and shall tremble at [ every ] moment , and be astonished at thee

traditions.WLC: וְ חָֽרְדוּ֙ לִ רְגָעִ֔ים וְ שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָֽיִ ךְ
traditions.VUL: et attóniti super repentíno casu tuo admirabúntur .
traditions.KJV: and shall tremble at [ every ] moment , and be astonished at thee .

17.english_reference: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee

traditions.WLC: וְ נָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִ ךְ קִינָה֙
traditions.VUL: Et assuméntes super te laméntum ,
traditions.KJV: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee ,

17.english_reference: and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , [ that wast ] inhabited of seafaring men

traditions.WLC: וְ אָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔ ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מִ יַּמִּ֑ים
traditions.VUL: dicent tibi : Quómodo perísti , quæ hábitas in mari ,
traditions.KJV: and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , [ that wast ] inhabited of seafaring men ,

17.english_reference: the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants

traditions.WLC: הָ עִ֣יר הַ הֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַ יָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְ יֹשְׁבֶ֔י הָ
traditions.VUL: urbs ínclyta , quæ fuísti fortis in mari cum habitatóribus tuis ,
traditions.KJV: the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants ,

17.english_reference: which cause their terror [ to be ] on all that haunt it

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ ם לְ כָל יוֹשְׁבֶֽי הָ
traditions.VUL: quos formidábant univérsi ?
traditions.KJV: which cause their terror [ to be ] on all that haunt it !

18.english_reference: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall

traditions.WLC: עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽ אִיִּ֔ן י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּ֑ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Nunc stupébunt naves in die pavóris tui :
traditions.KJV: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall ;

18.english_reference: yea , the isles that [ are ] in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure

traditions.WLC: וְ נִבְהֲל֛וּ הָ אִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּ יָּ֖ם מִ צֵּאתֵֽ ךְ
traditions.VUL: et turbabúntur ínsulæ in mari , eo quod nullus egrediátur ex te .
traditions.KJV: yea , the isles that [ are ] in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .

19.english_reference: For thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the Lord GOD ;

19.english_reference: When I shall make thee a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited

traditions.WLC: בְּ תִתִּ֤ י אֹתָ ךְ֙ עִ֣יר נֶחֱרֶ֔בֶת כֶּ עָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא נוֹשָׁ֑בוּ
traditions.VUL: Cum dédero te urbem desolátam sicut civitátes , quæ non habitántur :
traditions.KJV: When I shall make thee a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited ;

19.english_reference: when I shall bring up the deep upon thee , and great waters shall cover thee

traditions.WLC: בְּ הַעֲל֤וֹת עָלַ֨יִ ךְ֙ אֶת תְּה֔וֹם וְ כִסּ֖וּ ךְ הַ מַּ֥יִם הָ רַבִּֽים
traditions.VUL: et addúxero super te abýssum , et operúerint te aquæ multæ :
traditions.KJV: when I shall bring up the deep upon thee , and great waters shall cover thee ;

20.english_reference: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time

traditions.WLC: וְ הוֹרַדְתִּי ךְ֩ אֶת י֨וֹרְדֵי ב֜וֹר אֶל עַ֣ם עוֹלָ֗ם
traditions.VUL: et detráxero te cum his , qui descéndunt in lacum ad pópulum sempitérnum ,
traditions.KJV: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time ,

20.english_reference: and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ הוֹשַׁבְתִּי ךְ בְּ אֶ֨רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֜וֹת כָּ חֳרָב֤וֹת מֵֽ עוֹלָם֙ אֶת י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר
traditions.VUL: et collocávero te in terra novíssima sicut solitúdines véteres cum his , qui deducúntur in lacum ,
traditions.KJV: and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit ,

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֖עַן לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֑בִי
traditions.VUL: ut non habitéris :
traditions.KJV: that thou be not inhabited ;

20.english_reference: and I shall set glory in the land of the living

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֥י צְבִ֖י בְּ אֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים
traditions.VUL: porro cum dédero glóriam in terra vivéntium ,
traditions.KJV: and I shall set glory in the land of the living ;

21.english_reference: I will make thee a terror

traditions.WLC: בַּלָּה֥וֹת אֶתְּנֵ֖ ךְ
traditions.VUL: in níhilum rédigam te ,
traditions.KJV: I will make thee a terror ,

21.english_reference: and thou [ shalt be ] no [ more ]

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵינֵ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρξεις ἔτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: et non eris ,
traditions.KJV: and thou [ shalt be ] no [ more ] :

21.english_reference: though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again

traditions.WLC: וּֽ תְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְ לֹֽא תִמָּצְאִ֥י עוֹד֙ לְ עוֹלָ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et requisíta non inveniéris ultra in sempitérnum ,
traditions.KJV: though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהֹוִֽה
traditions.VUL: dicit Dóminus Deus .
